scope.independence_note: The reviewer authored ShadowData and its regression repair. That implementation is excluded from the independent verdict and is covered by a separate /root/m42_capture_tools review. Its CPU/HLSL blending contract and integration call sites were checked here.

findings.before: Deferred sampled the next cascade over the preceding ten-percent transition band, while CPU cascade bounds covered only the nominal next interval. For vertical FOV 1 degree, linear splits, near 0.05, distance 50 and rays +X, view depth 11.913125 projected to next-cascade x 1.086585 and received an unintended fully lit fallback.
findings.repair: Fit each following receiver interval backward over the preceding transition, preserving all nominal reported split distances. CPU SHADOW_CASCADE_BLEND_FRACTION is uploaded through FrameConstants.arrLighting[2] and HLSL uses Lighting.z.
findings.repair_authorship: ShadowData repair by this reviewer, integration/shared constant upload by root; independent mathematical re-review assigned to /root/m42_capture_tools

findings.before: A disabled shadow configuration with camera near 1 and shadow distance 0.1 still entered cascade generation, causing the otherwise valid camera render to fail.
findings.repair: Reset shadow output, and only compute caster bounds and directional cascades when enabled. Disabled draws still clear four slices, and the shader returns visibility one before sampling.

observed_gpu.binary_boundary: Observed root r3 report. Final build includes shared blend upload and is separately bound below.

review_checks: FrameConstants is 544 bytes and uses a 768-byte aligned prefix. Draw upload records follow that prefix in 256-byte slots in both shadow and GBuffer binding code.
Shadow pass b2 points at one 64-byte matrix in each 256-byte shadow upload slot. Geometry b0 and light b1 layouts remain consistent with HLSL.
Each frame owns a four-slice R32_TYPELESS depth array with D32_FLOAT DSVs and one R32_FLOAT array SRV. Slice/descriptor indexing stays within allocated heaps.

Graph declares writes for all four shadow subresources, transitions each to shader read before lighting and restores depth-write state after use. Frame reuse and resize retain graphics/compute fence retirement.
Reverse-Z shadows clear to zero and compare receiver depth plus bias >= stored depth. Normal bias offsets the receiver along its decoded normal.
Directional light normalization scales by the largest absolute component before length calculation, preserving valid huge and subnormal nonzero directions before float conversion.
The GPU blend width is supplied from the CPU blend constant via Lighting.z. Following cascade receiver coverage includes that transition band.
Shadow bounds use all local AABB corners and outward-rounded affine accumulation. Negative scale, shear, singular transforms and finite overflow cases retain explicit behavior.
Shadow shader uses matching base texture sampler, alpha multiplier and cutoff for MASK materials. Mirrored and double-sided PSO variants match the visible draw orientation.
Optional light/shadow objects preserve old configuration documents. Exact nested fields, valid resolutions, finite ranges and nonzero directional rays are checked before output replacement.

observed_runs.boundary: Regression result for reviewer-owned implementation, included as observed testing and excluded from the independent review verdict.

boundaries: This slice provides four directional CSM slices and fixed 3x3 PCF. Spot/point shadows, PCSS, virtual shadow pages and full M4.3 effects remain tracked follow-up work.
All caster world bounds conservatively affect each cascade depth range. Per-frame bounds construction traverses source vertices and has an explicit performance cost for future caching work.
The review observes CPU tests and the root-provided disabled-shadow GPU report. Final full-scene GPU, capture and image comparisons are maintained by /root/m42_network_acceptance.
Shadow allocation is bounded by validated resolution and three frame contexts. This review does not establish a total-process or total-GPU memory ceiling.

independent_shadow_data_review.scope: Reviewer-owned ShadowData implementation and blend-interval repair were independently reviewed and recompiled by the other agent.

post_review_identifier_change.change: Seven uses of local arrRanges renamed to arrDescriptorRanges; exact source replacement verified in build review and impact evidence.
